title: Visible login entry point and reliable admin moderation access

requirements.summary: Expose a consistent Login/Logout control in the global header and add a prominent Home hero Login call-to-action for logged-out users.
acceptanceCriteria: When browsing any page while logged out, the header contains a visible "Login" control that navigates to /login.
When logged in, the header no longer shows "Login" and instead provides a visible "Logout" control.
On the Home page while logged out, a prominent "Login" button is visible in the hero section and navigates to /login.
All user-facing text added/changed is in English.

file_operations.description: Add a clearly visible auth entry point in the header: show a "Login" control that navigates to /login when unauthenticated, and a "Logout" control when authenticated (triggering Internet Identity clear + React Query cache clear). Keep existing navigation (Home, Articles, About, Contact) intact. Use the selected "authorization" component guidance for Internet Identity login/logout behavior and cache clearing; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

In the hero section, conditionally render a prominent "Login" call-to-action for unauthenticated users that navigates to /login, in addition to the existing Read/Share buttons. Use the selected "authorization" component guidance for determining authenticated vs guest state; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Ensure admin moderation remains reachable post-login and /admin correctly shows admin content for admins and access denied states for others.
acceptanceCriteria: After logging in with an admin identity, the header shows an "Admin" navigation option and it navigates to /admin.
On /admin as an admin, the Admin Moderation page loads and includes the "Awaiting Approval" area for reviewing/publishing submissions.
On /admin as a logged-out user, an access denied view is shown with a visible Internet Identity login prompt.
On /admin as a non-admin logged-in user, an access denied view is shown indicating lack of admin privileges.

file_operations.description: Adjust the admin-check query behavior so it only runs when the user is authenticated (guest users should not attempt admin checks), and ensure the returned loading/data states support correctly showing/hiding the Admin header link without accidental exposure. Use the selected "authorization" component guidance for role-based admin checks and guest handling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Verify and refine Admin link visibility so it appears only for authenticated admins and reliably navigates to /admin, while remaining hidden for guests and non-admin users. Use the selected "authorization" component guidance for role-based access control checks; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Harden /admin access gating: (1) when logged out, render the existing AccessDeniedState with a visible Internet Identity login prompt; (2) when logged in but not admin, render the existing AccessDeniedState indicating lack of admin privileges; (3) when admin, ensure the existing AdminModerationPage UI renders and includes the "Awaiting Approval" tab with pending submissions, optionally making it the default tab to guarantee immediate visibility. Use the selected "authorization" component guidance for access-denied UI patterns; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
